look_here_first: Inspect large oval leaves with rounded chestnut-like teeth and dense grayish pubescence beneath; then check the large acorn seated in a shallow cup.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Native mainly in East Texas and Gulf Coastal Plain bottomlands; target-zone nativity unconfirmed.

best_field_traits: large oval leaves with coarse rounded teeth
large acorns in shallow bowl-like cups

comparisons.key_distinctions: Overcup oak has a deep cup enclosing most of the nut and rounded leaf lobes. Chinkapin oak has smaller regularly toothed leaves; bur oak has deeply waisted leaves and a mossy-fringed cup.

diagnostic_image_plan: leaf top and gray hairy underside
